title: 220605_1942_FR_CrowdOutdoor.wav by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Crowd waiting outdoor, with thunder in the background. Here is a recording made during Parades Festival, which is held in Nanterre (near Paris, France) every year at the beginning of June. One can hear lot of people talking and chatting outdoor, while waiting for a street event. In the background, some distant thunder can be heard. Recorded in June 2022 with an Olympus LS-P4 (internal microphones, TRESMIC system on). Fade in/out and high pass filter at 140Hz -6dB/oct applied in audacity.
